source:
@@U03816@@
and yet, knowing my place,
I kept my eyes averted,
looking here and there,
for this and that,
searching out roots, mosses and bark—
acquainted as I am with their virtues—
and so the loving pair were left to themselves.

@@U03818@@
To hear you tell it,
there are whole worlds in there!
Woods, meadows, brooks, lakes!
Just listen to you!

@@U03820@@
Yes!
And there are, you poor innocents!
Unexplored depths no man has ever fathomed!
Room upon room,
court upon endless court,
and I searched out every one with care.
All at once, then, a burst of laughter
echoes through the cavernous spaces.
And when I look, I see a boy
leaping from the lady’s lap to the man’s,
from father to mother.
And the cooing and caressing,
the shouts and shrieks of love's silly banter,
jesting and pleasure,
this side and that!
I was as good as deaf!
He’s naked is what he is!
A wingless spirit!
Faunlike without animality!
Leaping on the ground,
the ground sends him skyward,
and on the second or third bound
he touches the vaulted roof!
translation:
@@U03816@@
然而，知道我的位置，
我一直把目光移开
到处看看，
为了这个和那个，
寻找树根、苔藓和树皮——
像我一样熟悉他们的美德——
就这样，这对恩爱夫妻就被留下了。

@@U03818@@
听你诉说，
那里有整个世界！
树林、草地、小溪、湖泊！
听你的！

@@U03820@@
是的！
还有，你们这些可怜的无辜者！
人类从未探索过的未探索的深度！
一个又一个房间，
法庭上无尽的法庭，
我仔细地搜查了每一个人。
一下子，爆发出一阵笑声
回声穿过洞穴般的空间。
当我看去时，我看到一个男孩
从女士的腿上跳到男人的腿上，
从父亲到母亲。
还有咕咕声和爱抚，
爱的愚蠢玩笑的叫喊和尖叫，
开玩笑和快乐，
这边和那边！
我当时就跟聋子一样！
他就是赤身裸体！
没有翅膀的精灵！
像农牧神一样没有动物性！
在地上跳跃，
大地把他送向天空，
在第二个或第三个界限上
他触碰到了拱形屋顶！
